nodes.title: Show the updated slide preview under the Slide Data display
nodes.summary: After the user saves the AI prompt response that includes the added images, render the slide being edited using pened-tools directly beneath the slide data display in the Slide Data view. The preview shows only the data of the slide currently being edited, not the rest of the deck, so the user can immediately see how the updated slide looks. Covers [fb_8d597e7c-5802-4e6e-825e-b89ed5a6d009].

## Goal to plan
Goal: Show the updated slide preview under the Slide Data display
Description: After the user saves the AI prompt response that includes the added images, render the slide being edited using pened-tools directly beneath the slide data display in the Slide Data view. The preview shows only the data of the slide currently being edited, not the rest of the deck, so the user can immediately see how the updated slide looks. Covers [fb_8d597e7c-5802-4e6e-825e-b89ed5a6d009].
Version: v1
